assumptions: The roadmap's opening equipment 100 is represented as an equivalent remaining cost 100, no opening accumulated depreciation and 60 remaining months. The reference-core sequence disables depreciation, interest and tax.
The roadmap gives total equity 100; allocating it to contributed capital, and the ten lakh opening shares, are teaching assumptions.
Opening due dates, 12% debt rate, 20% tax rate and minimum cash 3 are authored hypothetical extensions, not current legal or market terms.
Inventory cost sold is supplied and must not exceed the available carrying balance. No manufacturing costing, impairment, returns or foreign currency.
Interest uses Actual/365 simple daily accrual; depreciation is straight-line with actual available days per calendar month; tax applies only to positive period pre-tax income with no loss benefit.

Ordinary customer/supplier, operating expense, interest and tax payments are operating cash; equipment settlement investing; principal/owner funding and distributions financing. This is a conceptual classification convention, not statutory compliance.
